claims_and_limits: Intel and SAP describe a proof of concept connecting SAP EWM requests to autonomous robot movement and status feedback.
Intel reports operational improvements in the demonstration without a generalizable comparative benchmark.
The proof of concept does not establish scaled deployment or cross-site economics.

visual.shared_motif: A copper task path and a single warehouse mover among shelves; cover emphasizes the move, inner figure maps the conceptual feedback loop.
visual.status: Editorial concept based on a proof of concept, not a depiction of Intel's actual robot or a deployed warehouse.
